mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pay_entitlement (id, user_id, resource_key, balance, expires_at, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{user}, #{resource}, #{delta}, #{expires}, 0, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE balance = balance + VALUES(balance), expires_at = CASE WHEN expires_at IS NULL OR VALUES(expires_at) > expires_at THEN VALUES(expires_at) ELSE expires_at END, version = version + 1, updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
